title: Relocate CI and manifest verifiers to their final owners
goal: Move the public CI verifier into commands and the internal manifest verifier into engine while preserving public compatibility and base-owned validation.
acceptanceCriteria: commands/Invoke-IFXCiContract.ps1 is the canonical public CI verifier and the old ci path is a forwarding deprecation wrapper.
engine/Invoke-IFXManifestCheck.ps1 is the only manifest verifier implementation and the old internal scripts path is absent.
Validate, CI contract fixtures and manifest fixtures pass through the final authorities.
Command, TCB, compatibility and documentation manifests contain no active reference to the removed internal path.
Protected-change, policy-candidate and trusted-component candidate checks pass with exact authorization consumption.
